name: Elton Village Store

layers.essential_history: [[c:The village shop. Nearby was Jelly's Yard, where Miss Jelly ran a small school for girls before the 1850s.]]
layers.deeper_history: [[c:There is a parish council notice board here, the place to find out what's on in Elton.]]
layers.mystery: [[c:The village shop stands where an old cottage was. An old woman remembers that the Queen's servant, Mistress Carey, was crying and asked the way to the church.]]

sources.title: Elton Parish Council: A short history of Elton

directions_to_next: [[c:Head east along the lane past the school to the main road and Highgate Hall, about 300 metres.]]
support: [[c:Support the village: Elton Village Store is the village shop. Spending here helps keep it going.]]
